odc_type: incorrect type inference for overridden methods
observation_summary: The compiler incorrectly reports argument count mismatches or type errors when calling overridden methods that use @inheritDoc.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the compiler fails to correctly propagate the full parameter signature of a superclass method to an overriding method when using @inheritDoc. When a subclass method overrides a superclass method, the compiler was not correctly copying the remaining parameters from the superclass definition into the overriding method's type signature. This leads to an incorrect type check where the compiler believes the overriding method accepts fewer arguments than it actually should, causing false positive 'wrong argument count' warnings or incorrect type mismatches during analysis.
